description: A gallery whose images carry no alt, title or class hint. The only PII on the page is a face in an unlabelled photograph, so it is reachable through the vision channel and through nothing else - which is what makes this the one fixture where swapping the vision model can change a score. The other two images and the Luhn-invalid reference number are precision controls.

sensitive.note: No `literal`, deliberately: a face is pixels, not a string, so there is nothing for the leak test to grep. Redaction covers it in the image; the src attribute is not PII and is not removed. Unreachable from the DOM - IMG_VISUAL_RULES matches alt/title/src/class text and none here names a person - so only a detector looking at pixels finds it. That is the single reason this fixture exists.

benign.note: A bar chart. A face detector that fires here is spending redaction precision for nothing.
A company mark. Logos with rounded forms are a classic false positive for weak face detectors.
4417 2200 0000 0000 has a card-like shape and FAILS Luhn. Matching sixteen digits without validating is how a reference number becomes a redacted credit card.
An ordinary heading, and the accessible name metric 1 is scored on.
